name: Adrak vali chai
description: Water: 1 cup Milk: 1 cup (whole milk gives a creamy texture) Fresh Ginger (Adrak): 1 tablespoon (crushed or grated) Black Tea Powder/Leaves (Chai Patti): 2 teaspoons (like Assam CTC) Sugar: 2 teaspoons (adjust to taste or omit) Optional: 1 to 2 green cardamoms (crushed) for extra aroma
